name: Symmetric Pseudo-Inverse Calculation
definition: Computes the pseudoinverse of a symmetric matrix A given its SVD (V and diagonal D). It inverts the eigenvalues in D, handling near-zero values via a threshold.
summary: Symmetric Pseudo-Inverse Calculation computes the pseudoinverse of a symmetric matrix via eigendecomposition, using thresholding for stability and explicit reconstruction to preserve symmetry.
